name: MAXIS
recent: Maxis 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日公布第三季度业绩，并宣派第三次中期股息每股 4.5 仙。公司此前于 10 月 23 日宣布以最高 8300 万令吉向 Astro 旗下 MBNS 收购宽频业务资产。同期 EPF 多次申报持股变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 4.5 仙，除息日 11 月 27 日，派发日 12 月 22 日。
拟以最高 8300 万令吉向 MBNS（Astro 全资子公司）收购宽频业务资产，属关联方交易。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
risks: 董事 Faizul bin Abdullah 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日出售 28,000 股普通股。
EPF 在 8 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收 26.71 亿令吉，环比增长 1.1%，同比增长 3.7%；净利 4.47 亿令吉，环比增长 2.5%，同比增长 8.5%；净利率 16.7%，高于上一季度的 16.5%。

recent_en: Maxis announced its Q3 2026 results and a third interim dividend of 4.5 sen per share on 6 November 2026. Earlier, on 23 October, it announced the acquisition of broadband business assets from Astro's MBNS for up to RM83 million. EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding during the period.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 4.5 sen per share, ex-date 27 November, payment date 22 December.
Proposed acquisition of broadband business assets from MBNS (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Astro) for up to RM83 million, a related party transaction.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Director Faizul bin Abdullah disposed of 28,000 ordinary shares on 26 August 2026.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 revenue was RM2.671 billion, up 1.1% QoQ and 3.7% YoY; net income was RM447 million, up 2.5% QoQ and 8.5% YoY; net margin was 16.7% versus 16.5% in the previous quarter.
